items.title: FOSSi publishes Verilator talk on closing SystemVerilog support gaps
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Krzysztof Bieganski's Verilator talk. The video abstract reports progress toward broader verification support, including experimental four-state logic, improved constrained-random stimulus generation, remaining UVM scheduling and bug-fix work, SVA nearing feature completeness, and coverage-tooling updates.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 Verilator 讲座，聚焦补齐 SystemVerilog 支持缺口
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Krzysztof Bieganski 关于 Verilator 的讲座。视频摘要说明了扩展验证能力的进展，包括实验分支中的四态逻辑支持、受约束随机激励生成质量改进、UVM 调度与缺陷修复、SVA 接近功能完整，以及覆盖率工具相关更新。

items.title: FOSSi publishes coconext talk on a faster cocotb-style verification flow
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Kaleb Barrett's coconext talk. The abstract describes coconext as an experimental cocotb fork and redesign intended to address performance by adding a first-class cocotb-like C++ API, preserving the existing Python cocotb API, and connecting the two through a low-friction binding layer for mixed-language testbenches, models, monitors, and drivers.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 coconext 讲座，探索更快的 cocotb 风格验证流程
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Kaleb Barrett 关于 coconext 的讲座。视频摘要将其定位为实验性的 cocotb 分支与重构方向：引入作为一等接口的 cocotb 风格 C++ API，保留现有 Python API，并以易于集成的绑定层连接两者，改善测试平台、模型、监视器与驱动器的性能及混合语言开发体验。

items.title: Antmicro and Nuvoton advance NPCR1 OpenTitan support in Renode
items.summary: Antmicro and Nuvoton announced collaboration around Nuvoton secure chips in the open-source Renode simulation framework. The article says the work builds on existing Renode support for Nuvoton's NPCR1 OpenTitan Earl Grey Based Secure MCU IC, a RISC-V Root of Trust platform with secure accelerators and SPI/I2C/UART/USB/GPIO interfaces, enabling early firmware development, testing, and debugging.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 与 Nuvoton 推进 NPCR1 OpenTitan 的 Renode 支持
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 与 Nuvoton 围绕新唐安全芯片在开源仿真框架 Renode 中的支持展开合作。这项工作建立在 Renode 对 NPCR1 安全 MCU 的既有支持之上。NPCR1 基于 OpenTitan Earl Grey，是采用 RISC-V 的信任根平台，包含安全加速器和 SPI、I2C、UART、USB、GPIO 接口，可用于早期固件开发、测试和调试。

items.title: Caliptra runtime/FMC 1.3.0 adds MLDSA post-quantum support
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance published Caliptra runtime/FMC 1.3.0 with software support for PQC MLDSA. The release notes list PQC seed initialization, MLDSA signature verification, attestation for firmware downstream of Caliptra Core, and an update to the Rust 1.95 toolchain.
items.titleZh: Caliptra Runtime/FMC 1.3.0 增加 MLDSA 后量子支持
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 发布 Caliptra Runtime/FMC 1.3.0，加入后量子密码算法 MLDSA 的软件支持。发布说明列出后量子密码种子初始化、MLDSA 签名验证、面向 Caliptra Core 下游固件的证明机制，以及 Rust 1.95 工具链更新。

items.title: FOSSi publishes GVSoC talk on event-driven many-core simulation
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Rafael Medina Morillas's GVSoC talk. The abstract describes GVSoC as a configurable event-driven simulator for IoT processors and complex SoCs, using C++ models and Python configuration for faster prototyping, design exploration, full-platform many-core simulation, and integration with other simulators.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 GVSoC 讲座，介绍事件驱动的多核系统仿真
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Rafael Medina Morillas 关于 GVSoC 的讲座。视频摘要将 GVSoC 描述为面向 IoT 处理器和复杂 SoC 的可配置事件驱动仿真器，通过 C++ 模型和 Python 配置支持更快的原型设计、设计空间探索、完整平台多核仿真以及与其他仿真器集成。

items.title: FOSSi publishes Bucket functional-coverage tooling update
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Stuart Alldred's Bucket update talk. The official abstract describes Bucket as an open-source Python project for collecting and viewing functional coverage, now maintained by Noodle-Bytes after Vypercore shut down, with updates including an improved viewer, cross-run coverage comparison, a new archive format, and adoption by additional silicon companies.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 Bucket 功能覆盖率工具更新讲座
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Stuart Alldred 关于 Bucket 的更新讲座。官方摘要将其介绍为收集和查看功能覆盖率的开源 Python 项目；Vypercore 关闭后，由 Noodle-Bytes 接手维护。讲座涉及改进的查看器、跨运行覆盖率比较、新归档格式，以及更多芯片企业的采用情况。

items.title: FOSSi publishes Doppio talk on Java and Scala circuit verification
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Martin Schoeberl's Doppio talk. The official abstract presents Doppio as an open-source, software-based verification framework that applies software-testing ideas and modern programming languages such as Java and Scala to digital-circuit verification, aiming to modernize verification practices rooted in older hardware-verification languages.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 Doppio 讲座，探索 Java 与 Scala 电路验证
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Martin Schoeberl 关于 Doppio 的讲座。官方摘要将其介绍为开源的软件式验证框架，把软件测试方法及 Java、Scala 等现代编程语言用于数字电路验证，探索传统硬件验证语言之外的实践路径。

items.title: RISC-V architecture tests 4.1.0 expand privileged and vector coverage
items.summary: RISC-V architecture tests 4.1.0 is an official non-prerelease ACT release that expands architectural coverage and test generation. The release notes highlight added or improved privileged tests for Zawrs, Sstvala, Ssccptr, Zama16b, Zkr, exceptions, interrupts, PMP, and other areas, plus lower-privilege execution support and default Vx/Vls vector test generation on supported DUTs.
items.titleZh: RISC-V 架构测试 4.1.0 扩展特权架构与向量覆盖
items.summaryZh: RISC-V 架构测试 4.1.0 是官方非预发布版，扩展了架构覆盖与测试生成能力。发布说明重点列出 Zawrs、Sstvala、Ssccptr、Zama16b、Zkr、异常、中断和 PMP 等领域的特权测试改进，并加入低特权级执行支持；在支持的被测设计上，默认启用 Vx/Vls 向量测试生成。

items.title: cocotb 2.1.0 expands Python-based hardware verification workflows
items.summary: cocotb 2.1.0 is a substantial verification tooling release with an experimental pytest plugin, Python 3.14 support, Verilator SAIF tracing support, Questa QIS/Qrun runner support, richer test controls such as xfail and skipif, and scheduler, callback, JUnit, and simulator-integration fixes.
items.titleZh: cocotb 2.1.0 扩展基于 Python 的硬件验证流程
items.summaryZh: cocotb 2.1.0 包含实验性 pytest 插件、Python 3.14 支持、Verilator SAIF 跟踪支持、Questa QIS/Qrun 运行器支持，以及 xfail、skipif 等更丰富的测试控制；同时修复调度器、回调、JUnit 输出和仿真器集成中的问题。

items.title: FOSSi publishes Spade HDL talk with RISC-V core and RTL project examples
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Frans Skarman's Spade HDL talk. The abstract shifts from language introduction to concrete projects built with Spade, including RISC-V cores, Ethernet and camera-stack work, and a pure-RTL UI library.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 Spade HDL 讲座，展示 RISC-V 内核与 RTL 项目案例
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Frans Skarman 关于 Spade HDL 的讲座。视频摘要不再侧重语言本身，而是展示用 Spade 构建的项目，包括 RISC-V 内核、以太网与摄像头栈，以及纯 RTL UI 库。

items.title: Antmicro publishes OpenROAD workflows for peak, glitch, and scoped power analysis
items.summary: Antmicro described open-source power-analysis workflows built around OpenROAD, Verilator, trace2power, and OpenSTA. The workflows use VCD traces to report peak power by clock cycle, estimate glitch-related power from repeated transitions, and scope reports to selected modules after synthesis and place-and-route preparation.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 发布 OpenROAD 峰值、毛刺与模块级功耗分析流程
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 介绍了结合 OpenROAD、Verilator、trace2power 和 OpenSTA 的开源功耗分析流程：利用 VCD 波形按时钟周期报告峰值功耗，根据重复跳变估算毛刺相关功耗，并在完成综合和布局布线准备后，将报告范围限定到指定模块。

items.title: OpenTitan starts Peppermint, an integrated RoT for constrained SoCs
items.summary: lowRISC announced Peppermint as a new OpenTitan top level optimized for area-, cost-, and power-constrained SoCs such as wearables, IoT endnodes, and microcontrollers. The integrated Root of Trust is planned to handle secure boot, firmware updates, and cryptographic requests from the main SoC, with design work planned for H2 2026 and software plus verification completion in H1 2027.
items.titleZh: OpenTitan 启动面向资源受限 SoC 的 Peppermint 集成式信任根
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 宣布启动 OpenTitan 新顶层设计 Peppermint，面向可穿戴设备、物联网终端和微控制器等面积、成本与功耗受限的 SoC。该集成式信任根计划承担安全启动、固件更新及主 SoC 的密码运算请求；设计工作预计在 2026 年下半年进行，软件与验证预计于 2027 年上半年完成。

items.title: FOSSi publishes FuseSoC roadmap talk for IP and EDA-flow management
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Olof Kindgren's FuseSoC and Edalize roadmap talk. The abstract frames FuseSoC as a widely used IP-management solution with a public core registry and describes Edalize as an EDA-flow manager supporting more than 50 tools, then outlines planned features for managing, building, simulating, and analyzing larger designs.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 FuseSoC 路线图讲座，面向 IP 与 EDA 流程管理
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Olof Kindgren 关于 FuseSoC 与 Edalize 路线图的讲座。视频摘要将 FuseSoC 定位为广泛使用的 IP 管理方案，拥有公开 IP core 注册表，并介绍 Edalize 作为支持 50 多种工具的 EDA 流程管理器，后续方向聚焦大型设计的管理、构建、仿真与分析。

items.title: FOSSi publishes VeeR and Verilator talk on open fault-injection tooling
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Maciej Dudek's talk on radiation hardening and fault injection. The abstract covers ongoing Triple Modular Redundancy work for the CHIPS Alliance VeeR-EL2 open-source RISC-V core and new open Verilator-based tooling used to inject faults and verify the VeeR-EL2 TMR configuration.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 VeeR 与 Verilator 讲座，介绍开放故障注入工具
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Maciej Dudek 关于抗辐射加固与故障注入的讲座。视频摘要介绍了 CHIPS Alliance VeeR-EL2 开源 RISC-V 内核的三模冗余配置工作，以及围绕 Verilator 构建的开放故障注入工具，用于验证 VeeR-EL2 TMR 配置。

items.title: Caliptra MCU Runtime SDK 2.1.0 publishes a Rust/Tock RoT reference runtime
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance published the initial Caliptra 2.1 MCU Runtime SDK release, a Rust-based reference Root of Trust runtime built on Tock. The SDK includes reusable capsules, hardware-abstraction interfaces, reference drivers, userspace APIs, protocol stacks, reference applications, host tooling, and emulator plus FPGA reference platforms for SoC-specific integration.
items.titleZh: Caliptra MCU Runtime SDK 2.1.0 发布 Rust/Tock 信任根参考运行时
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 发布 Caliptra 2.1 MCU Runtime SDK 初始版本，提供基于 Tock 的 Rust 信任根参考运行时。SDK 包含可复用的 capsule 组件、硬件抽象接口、参考驱动、用户态 API、协议栈、参考应用和主机工具，以及供特定 SoC 集成使用的模拟器与 FPGA 参考平台。

items.title: FOSSi publishes Borg talk on a libre-toolchain open GPU tapeout
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Andreas Wendleder's Borg talk. The official abstract describes a small RISC-V SoC driving a tile-based FP16 GPU, built end-to-end with libre tools including Chisel, Yosys, LibreLane/OpenROAD, Verilator, and Nix, and submitted as an ASIC tapeout while exposing and fixing upstream toolchain issues.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 Borg 讲座，展示基于自由工具链的开源 GPU 流片
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Andreas Wendleder 关于 Borg 的讲座。官方摘要介绍了一个小型 RISC-V SoC 驱动的 tile-based FP16 GPU，使用 Chisel、Yosys、LibreLane/OpenROAD、Verilator 和 Nix 等自由工具端到端构建，并作为 ASIC 流片提交，同时暴露并修复了上游工具链问题。

items.title: OpenHW TV publishes a practical webinar on open RISC-V verification
items.summary: OpenHW TV published PlanV Tech's webinar on open verification for RISC-V and high-assurance silicon. The session connects UVM support for Verilator, industrial environments such as CORE-V-VERIF, emerging formal verification frameworks, and end-to-end trust concerns spanning RTL verification, formally verified device drivers, and trusted embedded systems.
items.titleZh: OpenHW TV 发布开放 RISC-V 验证实务讲座
items.summaryZh: OpenHW TV 发布 PlanV Tech 关于 RISC-V 与高可信芯片开放验证的线上讲座。内容串联 Verilator 的 UVM 支持、CORE-V-VERIF 等工业级验证环境、新兴形式化验证框架，以及从 RTL 验证到经过形式化验证的设备驱动和可信嵌入式系统的端到端信任。

items.title: FOSSi publishes ShapeIC talk on LUT-based analog IC exploration
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Daniel Arevalos' ShapeIC talk. The official abstract presents ShapeIC as an open-source project for fast analog integrated-circuit design-space exploration, using lookup-table characterization of devices and circuit primitives to reduce repeated full circuit simulation during hierarchical transistor sizing.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 ShapeIC 讲座，介绍基于查找表的模拟 IC 探索
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Daniel Arevalos 关于 ShapeIC 的讲座。官方摘要将 ShapeIC 描述为一个用于快速模拟集成电路设计空间探索的开源项目，通过对器件和电路基元进行查找表表征，在分层晶体管尺寸探索中减少重复的完整电路仿真。

items.title: OpenHW TV introduces RISC-V System-on-Chip Design with CORE-V Wally
items.summary: OpenHW TV published Prof. David Harris and Dr. Rose Thompson's webinar introducing RISC-V System-on-Chip Design and its hands-on course material around CORE-V Wally. The recording highlights a practical open-source SoC platform spanning RV32I and RV64I, Linux-capable virtual memory, caches, branch prediction, RISC-V extensions, simulation, analysis, extension, and FPGA use.
items.titleZh: OpenHW TV 介绍基于 CORE-V Wally 的 RISC-V SoC 设计课程
items.summaryZh: OpenHW TV 发布 David Harris 教授与 Rose Thompson 博士的线上讲座，介绍 RISC-V System-on-Chip Design 及围绕 CORE-V Wally 的实践课程。录制内容以开源 SoC 平台为基础，涉及 RV32I/RV64I、支持 Linux 的虚拟内存、缓存、分支预测和 RISC-V 扩展，以及仿真、分析、扩展设计和 FPGA 实践。

items.title: FOSSi publishes SpiceBind talk connecting SPICE and RTL verification
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Tomasz Hemperek's SpiceBind talk. The official abstract frames SpiceBind as a project that connects ngspice to a VPI-capable HDL simulator, placing it in the growing open-source analog/mixed-signal verification stack alongside open PDKs, circuit simulators, design tools, and libraries.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 SpiceBind 讲座，连接 SPICE 与 RTL 验证流程
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Tomasz Hemperek 关于 SpiceBind 的讲座。官方摘要将 SpiceBind 描述为一个把 ngspice 连接到支持 VPI 的 HDL 仿真器的项目，并把它放在开放 PDK、电路仿真器、设计工具和库共同发展的开源模拟/混合信号验证体系中。

items.title: Antmicro introduces Faultergeist for SEU fault injection in Verilator
items.summary: Antmicro introduced Faultergeist, an open-source fault-injection framework for testing digital designs against single-event upset vulnerability in Verilator. The workflow generates fault campaigns with Weibull and Bendel cosmic-radiation models validated against irradiation data, then injects bit flips at simulation runtime through a VPI plugin.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 推出面向 Verilator 的单粒子翻转故障注入工具 Faultergeist
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 介绍了开源故障注入框架 Faultergeist，用于在 Verilator 中测试数字设计对单粒子翻转的敏感性。流程采用由辐照数据校验的 Weibull 与 Bendel 宇宙辐射模型生成故障测试任务，再通过 VPI 插件在仿真运行时注入比特翻转。

items.title: OpenTitan Earl Grey 2 adds a low-power I3C controller and target block
items.summary: lowRISC describes an I3C interface for OpenTitan Earl Grey 2, with SDR raw bitrates up to 12.5 Mbps and HDR-DDR up to 25 Mbps. These are raw bitrates, not effective payload throughput. The article also explains low-power operation and SCL drive control.
items.titleZh: OpenTitan Earl Grey 2 增加低功耗 I3C controller/target IP
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 介绍了 OpenTitan Earl Grey 2 的 I3C 接口：SDR 原始比特率最高 12.5 Mbps，HDR-DDR 最高 25 Mbps。这里指原始比特率，并非扣除协议开销后的有效吞吐量；文章还说明了低功耗运行与 SCL 驱动控制。

items.title: FOSSi publishes Spire talk on HDL-level optimization intent
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Felix Arnold's Spire talk. The official abstract describes Spire as a Python-embedded HDL that lets designers express optimization intent in source code and apply transformations such as arithmetic architecture selection and fusion, FSM minimization, and ABC-backed logic optimization.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 Spire 讲座，探索在 HDL 中表达优化意图
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布了 Felix Arnold 关于 Spire 的讲座。官方摘要介绍 Spire 是一种嵌入 Python 的 HDL，让设计者在源代码中表达优化意图，并应用算术结构选择与融合、FSM 最小化以及基于 ABC 的逻辑优化等转换。

items.title: CIRCT firtool 1.155.0 updates HW, LLHD, ESI, Moore, FIRRTL, and RTG flows
items.summary: LLVM CIRCT published firtool 1.155.0 with hardware-compiler updates including aggregate-constant support in HW bitcast folding, broader LLHD loop-unrolling support, ESI runtime and channel work, Moore/SystemVerilog lowering fixes, FIRRTL domain and constant-expression updates, RTG effect-system additions, and BMC trace/counterexample handling.
items.titleZh: CIRCT firtool 1.155.0 更新 HW、LLHD、ESI、Moore、FIRRTL 与 RTG 流程
items.summaryZh: LLVM CIRCT 发布 firtool 1.155.0，硬件编译器更新包括 HW bitcast fold 的 aggregate constant 支持、更完整的 LLHD loop unrolling、ESI runtime/channel 工作、Moore/SystemVerilog lowering 修复、FIRRTL domain 与 constant-expression 更新、RTG effect system 增强，以及 BMC trace/counterexample handling。

items.title: Yosys 0.68 adds SymFPU passes and trims legacy synthesis options
items.summary: Yosys 0.68 is a formal open EDA release that adds the symfpu and symfpu_convert passes, removes several legacy or superseded options from ABC, flowmap, synth, synth_ice40, and read_aiger flows, and includes compatibility fixes such as Radiant netlist handling.
items.titleZh: Yosys 0.68 新增 SymFPU pass，并清理旧 synthesis options
items.summaryZh: Yosys 0.68 是一次正式的 open EDA 发布，新增 symfpu 与 symfpu_convert pass，移除 ABC、flowmap、synth、synth_ice40 与 read_aiger 流程中的若干旧选项或已替代选项，并包含 Radiant netlist compatibility 等修复。

items.title: Tenstorrent tt-metal v0.75.0 advances Quasar, Blackhole, TT-NN, and model flows
items.summary: Tenstorrent published tt-metal v0.75.0 as the latest final release in its open AI accelerator stack, with broad LLK, Metalium, and TT-NN changes for Quasar and Blackhole, SFPU accuracy and tiny-tile work, trace and fabric improvements, fused MoE and SDPA fixes, and model bring-up across Llama, Qwen, Kimi, Gemma, and DeepSeek workloads.
items.titleZh: Tenstorrent tt-metal v0.75.0 推进 Quasar、Blackhole、TT-NN 与模型流程
items.summaryZh: Tenstorrent 发布 tt-metal v0.75.0，这是其开放 AI accelerator stack 的最新正式版；更新覆盖 Quasar 与 Blackhole 的 LLK、Metalium、TT-NN 改动，SFPU accuracy 与 tiny-tile 支持、trace/fabric 改进、fused MoE 与 SDPA 修复，以及 Llama、Qwen、Kimi、Gemma、DeepSeek 等 workload 的 model bring-up。

items.title: Google joins the OpenROAD Initiative as a principal member
items.summary: Google announced that it formally joined the OpenROAD Initiative as a principal member, with Aaron Cunningham appointed to the ORI Governing Board. The announcement frames the membership around neutral open-source EDA stewardship, ecosystem growth, workforce development, CI/CD strengthening, PDK enablement, and improving the OpenROAD user experience.
items.titleZh: Google 以最高会员层级加入 OpenROAD Initiative
items.summaryZh: Google 宣布正式以最高会员层级加入 OpenROAD Initiative，并任命 Aaron Cunningham 进入 ORI 治理委员会。公告将这一会员资格定位于支持中立的开源 EDA 治理、生态增长、人才培养、CI/CD 强化、PDK 使能与 OpenROAD 使用体验改进。

items.title: FOSSi publishes RIVET talk on a Chisel Ethernet MAC generator for RISC-V SoCs
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation published Vladimir Milovanovic's ORConf 2026 talk on RIVET, a Chisel-based Ethernet MAC generator for RISC-V systems. The talk and linked project materials describe multi-rate MAC interfaces, DMA, ARP, IPv4, UDP, TileLink, AXI4-Stream, cocotb/Verilator testing, and Chipyard-oriented integration for network-capable ASIC and FPGA prototypes.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 RIVET 演讲：面向 RISC-V SoC 的 Chisel 以太网 MAC 生成器
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 发布 Vladimir Milovanovic 在 ORConf 2026 的 RIVET 演讲，介绍面向 RISC-V 系统的 Chisel 以太网 MAC 生成器。演讲与关联项目材料涵盖多速率 MAC 接口、DMA、ARP、IPv4、UDP、TileLink、AXI4-Stream、cocotb/Verilator 测试，以及面向 Chipyard 的集成，用于构建具备网络能力的 ASIC 与 FPGA 原型。

items.title: Chisel 7.14.0 deprecates implicit truncation and adds explicit width-control APIs
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance released Chisel 7.14.0 with a notable migration signal for hardware designers: implicit truncation is deprecated through firtool warnings, while new APIs add domain helpers, an LTL always operator, wide logical operators, Option support for Connectable, and an explicit truncating connection operator.
items.titleZh: Chisel 7.14.0 弃用隐式截断，并加入显式位宽控制 API
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 发布 Chisel 7.14.0，对硬件设计者给出重要迁移信号：通过 firtool 警告弃用隐式截断，同时新增 domain 辅助 API、LTL always 操作符、宽逻辑操作符、Connectable 的 Option 支持，以及显式截断连接操作符。

items.title: Yosys 0.69 removes legacy synthesis options and adds a SystemVerilog 2023 flag
items.summary: YosysHQ released Yosys 0.69 with cleanup that affects synthesis scripts: legacy abc, coolrunner2, greenpak4, nlutmap, retiming, abc9, abc2, and logger stderr options were removed, while the Verific frontend gained a -sv2023 flag for SystemVerilog 2023 support.
items.titleZh: Yosys 0.69 移除旧综合选项，并新增 SystemVerilog 2023 标志
items.summaryZh: YosysHQ 发布 Yosys 0.69，对综合脚本有迁移影响：移除了旧的 abc、coolrunner2、greenpak4、nlutmap、retiming、abc9、abc2 与 logger stderr 相关选项，同时 Verific 前端新增 -sv2023 标志以支持 SystemVerilog 2023。

items.title: CIRCT firtool 1.157.0 improves ESI cosimulation, FIRRTL, Moore, and synthesis flows
items.summary: LLVM's CIRCT project released firtool 1.157.0 with ESI cosimulation build improvements for Verilator FST tracing, FIRRTL initial-value and inliner updates, Moore lowering fixes, ImportVerilog type checking, and circt-synth datapath simplifications.
items.titleZh: CIRCT firtool 1.157.0 改进 ESI 协同仿真、FIRRTL、Moore 与综合流程
items.summaryZh: LLVM 的 CIRCT 项目发布 firtool 1.157.0，包含面向 Verilator FST tracing 的 ESI 协同仿真构建改进、FIRRTL 初始值与内联器更新、Moore 降低修复、ImportVerilog 类型检查，以及 circt-synth 数据通路简化。

items.title: RISER details an FPGA-assisted RISC-V microserver prototype
items.summary: RISC-V International published a RISER project snapshot on a microserver platform for European RISC-V cloud-server and accelerator prototyping. The article describes an FPGA-assisted standalone node that integrates the EPAC1.5 RISC-V vector-processor test chip with boot firmware, NVMe storage, and 100 Gbps Ethernet, and links the work to bring-up and use-case validation challenges.
items.titleZh: RISER 介绍 FPGA 辅助的 RISC-V 微服务器原型
items.summaryZh: RISC-V International 发布 RISER 项目介绍，展示面向欧洲 RISC-V 云服务器与加速器原型的微服务器平台。该独立节点采用 FPGA 辅助，集成 EPAC1.5 RISC-V 向量处理器测试芯片、启动固件、NVMe 存储及 100 Gbps 以太网，并讨论系统启动调试和应用验证中的集成难点。

items.title: Caliptra firmware 2.0.3 strengthens DPE, authorization, and subsystem flows
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance published Caliptra firmware 2.0.3 as a combined runtime and FMC release. The release adds MCU runtime anchoring in the Caliptra-managed DPE chain, SoC manifest preamble DPE contexts, owner authorization manifest support, tagged DPE context SVN reporting, larger DMA image hashing, dynamic entropy_src power handling, staged subsystem OTP provisioning, and security/runtime fixes around DPE cache hardening, PAUSER validation, reserved firmware IDs, and PL0 authorization boundaries.
items.titleZh: Caliptra 固件 2.0.3 强化 DPE、授权与子系统流程
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 发布合并运行时与 FMC 的 Caliptra 固件 2.0.3。更新包括将 MCU 运行时纳入 Caliptra 管理的 DPE 链、SoC 清单前导部分的 DPE 上下文、所有者授权清单、带标签 DPE 上下文的 SVN 报告、大于 1 MiB 镜像的 DMA 哈希、entropy_src 动态功耗处理，以及分阶段子系统 OTP 配置。另修复 DPE 缓存加固、PAUSER 校验、保留固件 ID 和 PL0 授权边界等安全及运行时问题。

items.title: RISC-V International spotlights EDACrux for RVFI-based core debug
items.summary: RISC-V International profiled Ferrite Engineering's EDACrux suite for RISC-V chip design and verification. The article highlights WaveCrux, NetCrux, LintCrux, and SimCrux cross-probing, with WaveCrux using RVFI signals to inspect retired instructions and run consistency checks against the RISC-V ISA specification for cores such as Ibex, CVA6, PicoRV32, SERV, and VeeR.
items.titleZh: RISC-V International 介绍基于 RVFI 的 EDACrux 内核调试
items.summaryZh: RISC-V International 介绍 Ferrite Engineering 的芯片设计与验证套件 EDACrux，重点说明 WaveCrux、NetCrux、LintCrux 与 SimCrux 之间的交叉定位。WaveCrux 利用 RVFI 信号检查已退休指令，并针对 Ibex、CVA6、PicoRV32、SERV、VeeR 等内核执行与 RISC-V ISA 规范的一致性检查。

items.title: Antmicro adds host-controller support to the CHIPS Alliance open-source I3C Core
items.summary: Antmicro described Host Controller support for the CHIPS Alliance open-source I3C Core, connecting the IP to Caliptra, Guineveer, the VeeR EL2 RISC-V core, and AXI-based SoC building blocks for more reusable open peripheral fabrics.

relatedSources.title: CHIPS Alliance I3C Core adds host-controller support with simulation and FPGA validation

items.titleZh: Antmicro 为 CHIPS Alliance 开源 I3C Core 加入 host-controller 支持
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 介绍了为 CHIPS Alliance 开源 I3C Core 实现 Host Controller 支持的工作，并将该 IP 与 Caliptra、Guineveer、VeeR EL2 RISC-V core 以及基于 AXI 的 SoC building block 串联起来，增强开放外设互连与复用能力。

items.title: RISC-V International publishes open workflow for migrating custom extensions into compliant opcode space
items.summary: RISC-V International highlighted a two-phase extension-migration workflow that uses the RISC-V Unified Database as the source of truth, MCP-connected LLM tooling for conflict analysis and remapping proposals, and open hardware/software artifacts including packed-SIMD extensions, simulator support, GNU assembler integration, Zephyr runtime support, and RTL for more than 140 migrated instructions.
items.titleZh: RISC-V International 发布自定义扩展迁移到合规 opcode space 的开放流程
items.summaryZh: RISC-V International 介绍了一套两阶段 extension migration workflow：以 RISC-V Unified Database 作为 source of truth，用连接 MCP tools 的 LLM 做编码冲突分析和 remapping 建议，并开源 packed-SIMD extensions、full-system simulator、GNU assembler support、Zephyr runtime support，以及超过 140 条迁移指令的 RTL。

items.title: Antmicro joins the OpenROAD Initiative to support open-source silicon design tooling
items.summary: Antmicro announced that it has joined the OpenROAD Initiative after long-running contributions to the OpenROAD project, framing the move around transparent governance, open-source FPGA and ASIC tooling, architecture exploration, silicon prototyping, and reproducible RTL-to-GDSII flows for faster chip-design feedback.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 加入 OpenROAD Initiative，支持开源硅设计工具生态
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 宣布加入 OpenROAD Initiative；它此前已长期贡献 OpenROAD project。文章把这次加入定位为对 transparent governance、open-source FPGA/ASIC tooling、architecture exploration、silicon prototyping，以及可复现 RTL-to-GDSII flow 的投入，以缩短芯片设计反馈周期。

items.title: CIRCT firtool 1.154.0 updates Arcilator, ImportVerilog, Moore, BMC, and HWToLLVM flows
items.summary: CIRCT released firtool 1.154.0 with hardware-compiler updates including Arcilator stream printing and DLTI handling, circt-bmc support for verif.formal and verif.contract operations, ImportVerilog and Moore support for $readmemb/$readmemh, packed-struct bit-range fixes, and HWToLLVM union-buffer sizing through module DLTI.
items.titleZh: CIRCT firtool 1.154.0 更新 Arcilator、ImportVerilog、Moore、BMC 与 HWToLLVM 流程
items.summaryZh: CIRCT 发布 firtool 1.154.0，硬件编译器更新包括 Arcilator stream printing 与 DLTI handling、circt-bmc 对 verif.formal/verif.contract operations 的支持、ImportVerilog/Moore 对 $readmemb/$readmemh 的支持、packed struct bit-range 修复，以及 HWToLLVM 通过 module DLTI 计算 union buffer size。

items.title: Antmicro reaches an initial four-state logic milestone in Verilator
items.summary: Antmicro outlined an experimental four-state logic implementation for Verilator under a --fourstate flag, using paired two-state variables internally so open-source ASIC and FPGA teams can debug X and Z behavior with fewer blind spots.

relatedSources.title: Verilator reaches an initial four-state logic implementation milestone

items.titleZh: Antmicro 推进 Verilator 四值逻辑支持，达到初始里程碑
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 介绍了 Verilator 中实验性的四值逻辑实现：通过 `--fourstate` 开关启用，并在内部使用成对的二值变量表示，从而帮助开源 ASIC 与 FPGA 团队更好地调试 X、Z 行为。

items.title: OpenTitan Earl Grey 2 roadmap adds CHERI, PQC, I3C, and efficiency upgrades
items.summary: lowRISC published the OpenTitan Earl Grey 2 roadmap, positioning the next discrete hardware root of trust around optional CHERI memory safety, CNSA 2.0-aligned post-quantum cryptography accelerator work, a combined I3C controller/target, and area/power reductions while the design is upstreamed through H2 2026 and H1 2027.
items.titleZh: OpenTitan Earl Grey 2 路线图加入 CHERI、PQC、I3C 与效率升级
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 发布 OpenTitan Earl Grey 2 路线图，把下一代 discrete hardware root of trust 的重点放在可选 CHERI memory safety、面向 CNSA 2.0 的 post-quantum cryptography accelerator、I3C controller/target，以及面积和功耗优化；设计计划在 2026 年下半年到 2027 年上半年持续 upstream。

items.title: Qualcomm joins CHIPS Alliance as a Platinum member for open-source chip design
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance announced Qualcomm Technologies as a new Platinum Member, with Lu Dai joining the Governing Board and the alliance highlighting Qualcomm's SoC, verification, standards, and design-manufacturing flow expertise as support for open-source RTL, verification methodology, and automated hardware flows.
items.titleZh: Qualcomm 以 Platinum member 身份加入 CHIPS Alliance，推动开源芯片设计
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 宣布 Qualcomm Technologies 成为新的 Platinum Member，Lu Dai 加入 Governing Board；联盟特别强调 Qualcomm 在 SoC、verification、standards 以及 design-manufacturing flow 方面的经验，将支撑开源 RTL、验证方法学和自动化硬件流程。

items.title: Tenstorrent tt-metal v0.74.0 brings LLM model updates and TT-NN math fixes
items.summary: Tenstorrent published tt-metal v0.74.0 as a final release after the RC stream, with LLK/Metalium optimizations for atanh, asinh, and acosh, TT-NN scalar divide-by-zero fixes, and model bring-up work for Llama 3.2 3B, Qwen3 32B, Llama 3.3 70B, Phi-4, and Gemma4 on the Tenstorrent stack.
items.titleZh: Tenstorrent tt-metal v0.74.0 带来 LLM model 更新与 TT-NN 数学修复
items.summaryZh: Tenstorrent 发布 tt-metal v0.74.0 正式版，结束此前 RC/dev 候选流；该版本包含 LLK/Metalium 对 atanh、asinh、acosh 的优化、TT-NN scalar divide-by-zero 修复，以及面向 Tenstorrent stack 的 Llama 3.2 3B、Qwen3 32B、Llama 3.3 70B、Phi-4 和 Gemma4 bring-up。

items.title: Caliptra MCU ROM SDK 2.1.0 adds source-oriented RISC-V ROM integration controls
items.summary: Caliptra MCU SW released rom-sdk-2.1.0 as a platform-independent no_std RISC-V ROM library for Caliptra 2.1, adding OCP LOCK documentation, DOT and owner-key handling, field-entropy and fuse-layout guidance, MCU-side SVN anti-rollback, encrypted firmware boot support, ROM milestone hooks, and broader FPGA/reference-platform support.
items.titleZh: Caliptra MCU ROM SDK 2.1.0 增加面向源码集成的 RISC-V ROM 控制项
items.summaryZh: Caliptra MCU SW 发布 rom-sdk-2.1.0，这是面向 Caliptra 2.1 的 platform-independent no_std RISC-V ROM library；它新增 OCP LOCK 文档、DOT 与 owner-key handling、field entropy 与 fuse layout 指引、MCU-side SVN anti-rollback、encrypted firmware boot、ROM milestone hooks，以及更完整的 FPGA/reference-platform 支持。

items.title: CIRCT firtool 1.153.0 updates verification, ImportVerilog, Moore, ESI, and FIRRTL flows
items.summary: CIRCT firtool 1.153.0 is a formal release with firtool verification-pass registration, Moore/SystemVerilog string-lowering fixes, ImportVerilog hierarchical-reference and foreach-loop support, ESI runtime/codegen fixes, Arc coroutine-lowering updates, and FIRRTL LowerLayers and LowerMemory improvements; 1.153.1 followed as a small patch release.
items.titleZh: CIRCT firtool 1.153.0 更新 verification、ImportVerilog、Moore、ESI 与 FIRRTL 流程
items.summaryZh: CIRCT firtool 1.153.0 是一次正式发布，包含 firtool verification pass 注册、Moore/SystemVerilog 字符串 lowering 修复、ImportVerilog hierarchical reference 与 foreach loop 支持、ESI runtime/codegen 修复、Arc coroutine lowering 更新，以及 FIRRTL LowerLayers 和 LowerMemory 改进；随后 1.153.1 作为小型 patch release 发布。

items.title: Tampere University joins OpenTitan to advance RISC-V SoC security and PQC research
items.summary: lowRISC announced Tampere University as an OpenTitan academic partner, bringing SoC Hub work in hardware security, RISC-V architecture, cryptographic acceleration, PQC implementation, side-channel analysis, fault injection, and open-source SoC integration into the secure-silicon coalition.
items.titleZh: Tampere University 加入 OpenTitan，推进 RISC-V SoC security 与 PQC 研究
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 宣布 Tampere University 成为 OpenTitan academic partner，把 SoC Hub 在 hardware security、RISC-V architecture、cryptographic acceleration、PQC implementation、side-channel analysis、fault injection 和 open-source SoC integration 方面的研究带入 OpenTitan secure-silicon coalition。

items.title: OpenTitan publishes side-channel-hardened, hardware-accelerated ML-DSA implementation
items.summary: lowRISC detailed an upstream OpenTitan ML-DSA implementation that uses OTBN, KMAC, SIMD-style arithmetic, and a formally verified masking accelerator to fit a first-order side-channel-hardened post-quantum signature flow into 16 KiB of instruction memory and 32 KiB of data memory.
items.titleZh: OpenTitan 发布 side-channel-hardened、硬件加速的 ML-DSA 实现
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 详解了已进入 upstream OpenTitan 的 ML-DSA 实现：它结合 OTBN、KMAC、SIMD-style arithmetic 和 formally verified masking accelerator，将 first-order side-channel-hardened post-quantum signature flow 放入 16 KiB instruction memory 与 32 KiB data memory。

items.title: MLCommons opens Edge Agentic Inference submissions for MLPerf Inference v6.1
items.summary: MLCommons introduced an Edge Agentic Inference benchmark for MLPerf Inference v6.1, targeting on-device multi-turn LLM workloads on a single edge accelerator with Qwen3.6-27B, BFCL v4 accuracy, recorded coding replay, and a July 31 submission deadline.
items.titleZh: MLCommons 为 MLPerf Inference v6.1 开放 Edge Agentic Inference 提交
items.summaryZh: MLCommons 为 MLPerf Inference v6.1 推出 Edge Agentic Inference benchmark，面向单颗 edge accelerator 上的端侧多轮 LLM workload，使用 Qwen3.6-27B、BFCL v4 accuracy gate、recorded coding replay，并将提交截止日定为 7 月 31 日。

items.title: Yosys 0.67 lands sv-elab SystemVerilog flow and build-system updates
items.summary: Yosys 0.67 now requires CMake 3.28, Clang 16 or GCC 13, moves SystemVerilog support to sv-elab on top of slang, adds working Microsoft Visual Studio builds including ABC, and expands passes such as check_mem, arith_tree, equiv_opt, sim, proc, and latch handling.
items.titleZh: Yosys 0.67 引入 sv-elab SystemVerilog 流程与构建系统更新
items.summaryZh: Yosys 0.67 现在要求 CMake 3.28、Clang 16 或 GCC 13，将 SystemVerilog 支持迁移到基于 slang 的 sv-elab，并加入可工作的 Microsoft Visual Studio/ABC 构建，以及 check_mem、arith_tree、equiv_opt、sim、proc 和 latch handling 等 pass 更新。

items.title: MLPerf Tiny v1.4 reports edge-AI results across RISC-V cores, NPUs, and microcontrollers
items.summary: MLCommons described MLPerf Tiny v1.4 as an architecture-neutral benchmark for ultra-low-power AI, measuring accuracy, latency, and energy per inference across 25 system configurations from nine organizations, including Andes RISC-V configurations and accelerator-based submissions.
items.titleZh: MLPerf Tiny v1.4 发布覆盖 RISC-V core、NPU 与 MCU 的 edge-AI 结果
items.summaryZh: MLCommons 将 MLPerf Tiny v1.4 描述为面向超低功耗 AI 的架构中立 benchmark，围绕 accuracy、latency 与每次 inference 能耗进行比较；本轮包含 9 家组织的 25 个系统配置，包括 Andes RISC-V 配置和加速器方案。

items.title: RISC-V International showcases GAPses smart glasses running always-on edge inference
items.summary: RISC-V International highlighted GAPses, an open wearable research platform using the GAP9 ultra-low-power RISC-V multicore processor for on-device EOG/EEG signal processing and CNN inference, converting eye-movement signals into BLE events without cloud compute.
items.titleZh: RISC-V International 展示 GAPses 智能眼镜上的 always-on edge inference
items.summaryZh: RISC-V International 介绍 GAPses 这一开放可穿戴研究平台：它使用 GAP9 超低功耗 RISC-V multicore processor，在端侧完成 EOG/EEG 信号处理和 CNN inference，将眼动信号转成 BLE 事件，无需云端计算。

items.title: AMI joins the OpenTitan coalition to connect firmware security with open secure silicon
items.summary: lowRISC announced that AMI joined the OpenTitan project, adding firmware-security and manageability expertise to a coalition that already includes Fraunhofer, Google, Nuvoton, and Realtek around transparent open-source secure silicon.
items.titleZh: AMI 加入 OpenTitan coalition，连接固件安全与开放安全硅
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 宣布 AMI 加入 OpenTitan 项目，为 OpenTitan coalition 带来固件安全和管理能力；该 coalition 已包括 Fraunhofer、Google、Nuvoton 与 Realtek，重点推进透明、可验证的开源安全硅。

items.title: Antmicro releases Topwrap 0.7.0 with cleaner SoC YAML and deeper SystemVerilog parsing
items.summary: Antmicro's Topwrap 0.7.0 update adds optimized component-based YAML syntax, initial clock/reset domain support with sanity checks, hierarchical SystemVerilog parsing into diagrams, GUI improvements, and planned Renode and IP-XACT integrations for SoC design flows.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 发布 Topwrap 0.7.0，改进 SoC YAML 与 SystemVerilog 解析
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 的 Topwrap 0.7.0 更新加入更清晰的 component-based YAML 语法、带 sanity check 的初始 clock/reset domain 支持、可生成图示的层级 SystemVerilog 解析、GUI 改进，以及后续 Renode 和 IP-XACT 集成规划。

items.title: CIRCT firtool 1.152.0 expands ImportVerilog, Moore simulation, Arc, and FIRRTL fixes
items.summary: LLVM CIRCT released firtool 1.152.0 with ImportVerilog and Moore simulation updates including fscanf/sscanf, timeformat, library-binding format specifiers, string-comparison lowering, Arc LowerProcesses work, and several FIRRTL inliner and dedup fixes.
items.titleZh: CIRCT firtool 1.152.0 扩展 ImportVerilog、Moore 仿真、Arc 与 FIRRTL 修复
items.summaryZh: LLVM CIRCT 发布 firtool 1.152.0，带来 ImportVerilog 与 Moore 仿真更新，包括 fscanf/sscanf、timeformat、library-binding 格式符、string-comparison lowering、Arc LowerProcesses，以及多项 FIRRTL inliner 与 dedup 修复。

items.title: RISC-V ISA Manual snapshot fixes bit-manipulation reference pseudocode
items.summary: RISC-V published a new ISA Manual snapshot built from commit f89d503. The official release notes call out a fix to the bit-manipulation reference pseudocode and link the full diff from the June 26 snapshot.
items.titleZh: RISC-V ISA Manual 快照修正 bit-manipulation 参考伪代码
items.summaryZh: RISC-V 发布基于 commit f89d503 的 ISA Manual 新快照；官方 release note 标出 bit-manipulation 参考伪代码修正，并链接了相对 6 月 26 日快照的完整差异。

items.title: lowRISC releases CHERI Mocha MVP-2 with CHERI-Linux boot and secure-enclave IP
items.summary: lowRISC announced the second MVP release of the CHERI Mocha Secure Enclave reference design. The subsystem SoC can boot CHERI Linux, adds secure-enclave IP blocks such as entropy, KMAC, ROM controller, SPI host, and debug support, and includes Genesys 2 board synthesis collateral.
items.titleZh: lowRISC 发布 CHERI Mocha MVP-2，支持 CHERI-Linux 启动与 secure-enclave IP
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 宣布 CHERI Mocha Secure Enclave 参考设计的第二个 MVP 版本；该 subsystem SoC 可启动 CHERI Linux，加入 entropy、KMAC、ROM controller、SPI host 与 debug support 等 secure-enclave IP，并提供 Genesys 2 板卡综合 collateral。

items.title: Antmicro runs Coral NPU SoC simulations with Renode and Verilator
items.summary: Antmicro detailed a simulation-driven Coral NPU flow that embeds a RISC-V-based Coral NPU block into an NXP i.MX 8M Plus Renode Linux demo, uses RVV example payloads, and runs UVM-based Coral NPU DV under Verilator through upstreamed flow changes.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 用 Renode 与 Verilator 运行 Coral NPU SoC 仿真
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 介绍了面向 Coral NPU 的仿真驱动流程：把基于 RISC-V 的 Coral NPU block 嵌入 NXP i.MX 8M Plus 的 Renode Linux demo，使用 RVV 示例 payload，并通过已上游的流程改动在 Verilator 下运行基于 UVM 的 Coral NPU DV。

items.title: Antmicro adds mockturtle extended technology mapping to OpenROAD resynthesis
items.summary: Antmicro described an OpenROAD resynthesis update that integrates mockturtle's extended mapper through a new resynth_emap command. In the published SKY130 jpeg_encoder example, multi-output mapping reduced area by roughly 10% after timing repair.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 为 OpenROAD resynthesis 加入 mockturtle extended technology mapping
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 介绍了 OpenROAD resynthesis 更新：通过新的 resynth_emap 命令集成 mockturtle extended mapper；在文章给出的 SKY130 jpeg_encoder 示例中，multi-output mapping 在 timing repair 后仍带来约 10% 面积下降。

items.title: RISC-V ISA Manual snapshot refreshes the Zkr example
items.summary: RISC-V published a new ISA Manual snapshot built from commit dc8bf2a. The release follows the June 23 snapshot and updates the Zkr example through RISC-V ISA Manual pull request 3227.
items.titleZh: RISC-V ISA Manual 快照更新 Zkr 示例
items.summaryZh: RISC-V 发布基于 commit dc8bf2a 的 ISA Manual 新快照；该版本延续 6 月 23 日快照，并通过 RISC-V ISA Manual pull request 3227 更新 Zkr 示例。

items.title: CIRCT firtool 1.151.0 fixes FIRRTL, ESI, Arc, SV, and Comb flows
items.summary: LLVM CIRCT published firtool 1.151.0. The release fixes invalid ESI connections from Unpack(pack()), addresses a FIRRTL inliner N-squared crash, lowers non-domain.define domain operands, adds Arc simulation-driver generation, extends the SV dialect with sv.fclose and sv.concat_str, supports sim.fmt.string printing in SimToSV, and fixes an O(NM) Comb extract-of-concat path.
items.titleZh: CIRCT firtool 1.151.0 修复 FIRRTL、ESI、Arc、SV 与 Comb 流程
items.summaryZh: LLVM CIRCT 发布 firtool 1.151.0；该版本修复 Unpack(pack()) 产生的无效 ESI connection、FIRRTL inliner 的 N 平方级崩溃、non-domain.define domain operand lowering，加入 Arc simulation-driver 生成，扩展 SV dialect 的 sv.fclose 与 sv.concat_str，支持 SimToSV 打印 sim.fmt.string，并修复 Comb extract-of-concat 的 O(NM) 路径。

items.title: Tenstorrent TT-Metalium v0.73.1 lands MoE, Gemma 4, DeepSeek, Quasar, and Metal 2.0 work
items.summary: Tenstorrent published TT-Metalium v0.73.1 as a final release for its open-source AI accelerator stack. The changelog includes MoE helper migration into C++ TT-NN, Gemma 4 performance and prefill/decode work, DeepSeek prefill and decode fixes, SDPA and KV-cache updates, Quasar LLK and firmware changes, Device 2.0 API migrations, fabric/dispatch improvements, and refreshed FW/KMD/SMI documentation.
items.titleZh: Tenstorrent TT-Metalium v0.73.1 推进 MoE、Gemma 4、DeepSeek、Quasar 与 Metal 2.0
items.summaryZh: Tenstorrent 发布 TT-Metalium v0.73.1，这是其开源 AI accelerator stack 的正式版本；变更包括将 MoE helper 迁移到 C++ TT-NN、Gemma 4 性能与 prefill/decode 工作、DeepSeek prefill 与 decode 修复、SDPA 和 KV-cache 更新、Quasar LLK 与 firmware 改动、Device 2.0 API 迁移、fabric/dispatch 改进，以及 FW/KMD/SMI 文档刷新。

items.title: RISC-V ISA Manual snapshot fixes Zca c.jal scope and Zvkt constant-time wording
items.summary: RISC-V published a new ISA Manual snapshot from commit cc30642. The release clarifies that c.jal is only in XLEN=32 Zca, connects unprivileged and privileged cross-references, and fixes the Zvkt DIEL constant-time instruction list for vmslt[u].vv and vrsub.vi.
items.titleZh: RISC-V ISA Manual 快照修正 Zca c.jal 范围与 Zvkt constant-time 表述
items.summaryZh: RISC-V 发布基于 commit cc30642 的 ISA Manual 新快照，明确 c.jal 只属于 XLEN=32 Zca，补上 unprivileged 与 privileged 章节交叉引用，并修正 Zvkt DIEL constant-time 指令列表中 vmslt[u].vv 与 vrsub.vi 的表述。

items.title: Caliptra FW 2.0.2 adds DPE upgrades, attested CSR, and FIPS hardening
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance published Caliptra FW 2.0.2 as a combined runtime and FMC release for the 2.0 branch. It adds DPE SVN and crypto API work, DPE ML-DSA hybrid mode, attested CSR mailbox commands, ML-DSA/ECDH pairwise tests, richer firmware verification reporting, recovery capability updates, and fixes around production debug unlock, mailbox validation, AES-GCM GHASH state, FIPS marking, and shutdown zeroization.
items.titleZh: Caliptra FW 2.0.2 加入 DPE 升级、attested CSR 与 FIPS 强化
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 发布 Caliptra FW 2.0.2，这是面向 2.0 branch 的 runtime 与 FMC 组合发布；它加入 DPE SVN 与 crypto API 工作、DPE ML-DSA hybrid mode、attested CSR mailbox command、ML-DSA/ECDH pairwise test、更完整的 firmware verification 信息与 recovery capability 更新，并修复 production debug unlock、mailbox validation、AES-GCM GHASH 状态、FIPS 标记和 shutdown zeroization 相关问题。

items.title: Caliptra FW 2.1.1 updates certification, activation, debug unlock, and crypto tests
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance published Caliptra FW 2.1.1 as the latest combined runtime and FMC release. The 2.1 branch update adds SIGN_WITH_EXPORTED_MLDSA, chunked DPE certificates, initial activation handling, and more fw_info telemetry, while fixing debug-unlock mailbox behavior, ActivateFirmware authorization and bitmap handling, manifest metadata bounds, AES-GCM streaming GHASH state, runtime startup KAT coverage, ML-KEM/ML-DSA/ECDH pairwise tests, FIPS shutdown zeroization, and mailbox PAUSER checks.
items.titleZh: Caliptra FW 2.1.1 更新 certification、activation、debug unlock 与 crypto tests
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 发布 Caliptra FW 2.1.1，这是最新的 runtime 与 FMC 组合发布；2.1 branch 更新加入 SIGN_WITH_EXPORTED_MLDSA、chunked DPE certificate、initial activation 处理和更多 fw_info telemetry，并修复 debug-unlock mailbox 行为、ActivateFirmware authorization 与 bitmap 处理、manifest metadata 边界、AES-GCM streaming GHASH 状态、runtime startup KAT 覆盖、ML-KEM/ML-DSA/ECDH pairwise test、FIPS shutdown zeroization 与 mailbox PAUSER 检查。

items.title: Chipyard 1.14.0 adds FireSim F2 support, Chisel 7 trials, and modular SoC builds
items.summary: Chipyard 1.14.0 is a broad RISC-V SoC generator release with AWS F2 support for FireSim, limited Chisel 7.13.0 support, modular lite builds, multichip and CTC improvements, Zephyr RTOS support, early Radiance/GPU integration, new FPGA/config examples, and updated Rocket Chip, BOOM, Shuttle, Saturn, Spike, Gemmini, and related submodules.
items.titleZh: Chipyard 1.14.0 加入 FireSim F2 支持、Chisel 7 试用与模块化 SoC 构建
items.summaryZh: Chipyard 1.14.0 是一次覆盖面很广的 RISC-V SoC generator 发布，加入面向 FireSim 的 AWS F2 支持、有限的 Chisel 7.13.0 支持、模块化 lite build、多芯片与 CTC 改进、Zephyr RTOS 支持、早期 Radiance/GPU 集成、新 FPGA/config 示例，并更新 Rocket Chip、BOOM、Shuttle、Saturn、Spike、Gemmini 等子模块。

items.title: Apache TVM introduces TIRx as an open hardware-native DSL for frontier ML kernels
items.summary: Apache TVM introduced TIRx, an open-source hardware-native DSL and compiler stack for ML kernels, shipping with the Apache TVM 0.25.0 Python package, documentation, a community kernel library, benchmarks, and course material for expert-written, agent-generated, and megakernel-style accelerator code.
items.titleZh: Apache TVM 推出 TIRx：面向前沿 ML kernel 的开放硬件原生 DSL
items.summaryZh: Apache TVM 推出 TIRx，这是面向 ML kernel 的开源硬件原生 DSL 与编译器栈；它随 Apache TVM 0.25.0 Python package、文档、社区 kernel library、benchmark 与课程材料一起发布，服务 expert-written、agent-generated 与 megakernel 风格的加速器代码。

items.title: CIRCT firtool 1.150.0 expands ImportVerilog, FIRRTL, Synth, ESI, and Arc flows
items.summary: CIRCT published firtool 1.150.0 with substantial open EDA compiler updates, including ImportVerilog support for use-before-declare, builtins, DPI export declarations, plusargs, assertions, and declaration handling; FIRRTL lowering and domain fixes; Synth and comb lowering work; ESI runtime improvements; and Arc coroutine lowering.
items.titleZh: CIRCT firtool 1.150.0 扩展 ImportVerilog、FIRRTL、Synth、ESI 与 Arc 流程
items.summaryZh: CIRCT 发布 firtool 1.150.0，包含一批开源 EDA 编译器更新：ImportVerilog 支持 use-before-declare、builtins、DPI export declaration、plusargs、assertion 与声明处理；同时改进 FIRRTL lowering/domain、Synth 与 comb lowering、ESI runtime，以及 Arc coroutine lowering。

items.title: Caliptra ROM 2.0.3 hardens shutdown, entropy, and debug-unlock handling
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance published Caliptra ROM 2.0.3 for the 2.0 branch, adding SS_STRAP_GENERIC[2] entropy-source configuration and CTR_DRBG-AES-256 plus MLDSA-87 KAT coverage, while fixing ROM shutdown zeroization, CSRNG health-test behavior, production debug unlock binding, boot-failure reporting, and FIPS marking around hash-based ECDSA/LMS verification.
items.titleZh: Caliptra ROM 2.0.3 强化 shutdown、entropy 与 debug unlock 处理
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 发布 Caliptra ROM 2.0.3（2.0 branch），新增 SS_STRAP_GENERIC[2] entropy source 配置以及 CTR_DRBG-AES-256、MLDSA-87 KAT 覆盖；同时修复 ROM shutdown zeroization、CSRNG health-test 行为、production debug unlock 绑定、boot failure 上报，以及 hash-based ECDSA/LMS verification 的 FIPS 标记。

items.title: Caliptra ROM 2.1.2 updates owner-key, ICCM verification, and recovery controls
items.summary: Caliptra ROM 2.1.2 adds Stable Owner Key derivation from the HEK seed and gates fatal-error reporting on the recovery reset strap, with fixes for firmware verification after ICCM load, entropy and CSRNG setup, production debug unlock rejection, ROM shutdown zeroization, OCP LOCK key-ladder use of DOE, and identity root-key write locks.
items.titleZh: Caliptra ROM 2.1.2 更新 owner key、ICCM verification 与 recovery 控制
items.summaryZh: Caliptra ROM 2.1.2 新增从 HEK seed 派生 Stable Owner Key，并通过 recovery reset strap gate fatal error reporting；修复内容覆盖 ICCM load 后固件验证、entropy 与 CSRNG 配置、production debug unlock 拒绝条件、ROM shutdown zeroization、OCP LOCK key ladder 使用 DOE，以及 identity root key write-lock。

items.title: Caliptra Subsystem 2.0.2 doc release clarifies collateral without RTL changes
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance released a documentation-only Caliptra Subsystem 2.0.2 collateral update that explicitly leaves the RTL design unchanged, follows the Caliptra subsystem release checklist, drops the volatile PK hash lock from the spec, and cherry-picks documentation clarifications from main.
items.titleZh: Caliptra Subsystem 2.0.2 文档发布澄清配套资料且不改 RTL
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 发布 Caliptra Subsystem 2.0.2 的 documentation-only collateral update，明确不修改底层 RTL 设计；该发布遵循 Caliptra subsystem release checklist，移除 spec 中的 volatile PK hash lock，并从 main cherry-pick 多项文档澄清。

items.title: RISC-V International unpacks SHD Group's 2026 market forecast methodology
items.summary: RISC-V International interviewed SHD Group on its 2026 RISC-V Market Analysis, explaining a top-down/bottom-up model across nearly 60 applications, 12 device types per system, and more than 70 ecosystem interviews, with headline 2031 forecasts of 35.9 billion RISC-V SoC units and $318 billion in associated revenue.
items.titleZh: RISC-V International 解读 SHD Group 2026 市场预测方法
items.summaryZh: RISC-V International 采访 SHD Group，解释其 2026 RISC-V Market Analysis 的方法：覆盖近 60 个应用、每个系统 12 类器件的 top-down/bottom-up 模型，并结合 70 多次生态访谈；报告给出的 2031 年 headline forecast 为 359 亿颗 RISC-V SoC 出货量和 3180 亿美元相关收入。

items.title: Apache TVM v0.25.0 lands Relax, frontend, TIR, runtime, and CI updates
items.summary: Apache TVM v0.25.0 is a final release, not an RC, with broad compiler/runtime maintenance across Relax, frontend importers, TIR analysis and scheduling, runtime backends, and developer workflow updates since v0.24.0.
items.titleZh: Apache TVM v0.25.0 发布，更新 Relax、frontend、TIR、runtime 与 CI
items.summaryZh: Apache TVM v0.25.0 是 final release（不是 RC），汇总了自 v0.24.0 以来在 Relax、frontend importer、TIR 分析与调度、runtime backend，以及开发流程方面的大量编译器和运行时维护更新。

items.title: Apache TVM FFI v0.1.12 advances its open ABI for ML systems
items.summary: Apache TVM FFI v0.1.12 adds reflection, Rust macro fixes, C-ABI-oriented AnyView changes, tensor API alignment, and ROCm/PyTorch DLPack loader fixes for the project's open ABI and framework-agnostic FFI layer for ML systems.
items.titleZh: Apache TVM FFI v0.1.12 推进面向 ML systems 的开放 ABI
items.summaryZh: Apache TVM FFI v0.1.12 为面向 ML systems 的开放 ABI 与跨框架 FFI 层加入 reflection、Rust macro 修复、面向 C ABI 的 AnyView 改动、tensor API 对齐，以及 ROCm/PyTorch DLPack loader 修复。

items.title: Antmicro runs Gemma 4 on its open hardware Jetson AGX Thor baseboard with Kenning
items.summary: Antmicro benchmarked Gemma 4 variants on its open hardware NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor baseboard, using the open-source Kenning framework with llama.cpp to generate performance reports for embedded edge-AI deployment.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 在开源 Jetson AGX Thor baseboard 上用 Kenning 运行 Gemma 4
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 在其开源 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor baseboard 上测试 Gemma 4 多个模型，并使用开源 Kenning 框架与 llama.cpp 生成性能报告，展示面向嵌入式 edge-AI 部署的开放硬件与软件栈。

items.title: FOSSi highlights ODE4EC's three-year push for open-source European chip design
items.summary: FOSSi's El Correo Libre Issue 98 says ODE4EC has begun as a three-year effort to strengthen Europe's open chip-design environment, with AMS, digital EDA, and productivity/verification projects for open EDA, open IP, and open PDK workflows.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 关注 ODE4EC 三年开放欧洲芯片设计计划
items.summaryZh: FOSSi 的 El Correo Libre 第 98 期介绍 ODE4EC 已启动：这是一个为期三年的欧洲开放芯片设计环境计划，覆盖 AMS、数字 EDA，以及生产力与验证工具项目，目标是推动开放 EDA、开放 IP 与开放 PDK 流程。

items.title: RVV study compares GCC 15 and Clang 21 on portable RISC-V vector performance
items.summary: A KTH, Lawrence Livermore, and Barcelona Supercomputing Center paper uses RVV 1.0 microbenchmarks on BananaPi-F3 and other RISC-V vector hardware to compare GCC 15 and Clang 21, finding GCC more stable across most scientific and ML proxy workloads while exposing remaining compiler and profiling gaps.
items.titleZh: RVV 研究比较 GCC 15 与 Clang 21 的 RISC-V vector 可移植性能
items.summaryZh: KTH、Lawrence Livermore 与 Barcelona Supercomputing Center 的论文使用 BananaPi-F3 等 RISC-V vector 硬件上的 RVV 1.0 microbenchmark 比较 GCC 15 与 Clang 21，发现 GCC 在多数科学计算与 ML proxy workload 上更稳定，同时暴露出编译器与性能分析工具仍需改进。

items.title: MLCommons publishes MLPerf Training v6.0 results for sparse MoE workloads
items.summary: MLCommons released MLPerf Training v6.0 results with new DeepSeek V3 and GPT-OSS 20B sparse MoE benchmarks, reporting 95 unique systems across thirteen hardware accelerators and broader cloud/on-premise training submissions.
items.titleZh: MLCommons 发布 MLPerf Training v6.0 结果，聚焦 sparse MoE workload
items.summaryZh: MLCommons 发布 MLPerf Training v6.0 结果，新增 DeepSeek V3 与 GPT-OSS 20B sparse MoE benchmark，并报告 95 个独立系统、13 类硬件加速器，以及更广泛的云端与本地训练系统提交。

items.title: Qualcomm reportedly weighs a Tenstorrent acquisition for RISC-V AI silicon
items.summary: Tom's Hardware, citing The Information, reported that Qualcomm has discussed acquiring Tenstorrent at an $8 billion to $10 billion valuation. The report is unconfirmed, but it is relevant to the open hardware brief because Tenstorrent's RISC-V-based AI accelerators and data-center CPU IP sit at the center of the rumored rationale.
items.titleZh: 报道称 Qualcomm 正评估收购 Tenstorrent，以强化 RISC-V AI silicon 布局
items.summaryZh: Tom's Hardware 援引 The Information 报道称，Qualcomm 曾讨论以 80 亿至 100 亿美元估值收购 Tenstorrent。该交易尚未确认，但对开源硬件简报有参考价值，因为报道中的核心理由正是 Tenstorrent 基于 RISC-V 的 AI accelerator 与数据中心 CPU IP。

items.title: OpenHW highlights EOSA webinar on Europe's open-source hardware ecosystem
items.summary: OpenHW promoted the European Open Source Academy webinar on the open-source hardware ecosystem, featuring OpenHW Group, RISC-V International, CERN, and Barcelona Supercomputing Center voices on European open hardware collaboration and adoption.
items.titleZh: OpenHW 关注 EOSA 欧洲开源硬件生态 webinar
items.summaryZh: OpenHW 介绍了 European Open Source Academy 关于开源硬件生态的 webinar，参与方包括 OpenHW Group、RISC-V International、CERN 与 Barcelona Supercomputing Center，主题聚焦欧洲开源硬件协作与采用。

items.title: OpenHW spotlights the inaugural RISC-V Ottawa community launch
items.summary: OpenHW highlighted the inaugural RISC-V Ottawa launch meeting, with Mike Thompson covering the open-source RISC-V ecosystem, Frederic Desbiens covering open-source RTOSes, and attendees shaping local project directions.
items.titleZh: OpenHW 关注 RISC-V Ottawa 首次社区启动会议
items.summaryZh: OpenHW 介绍 RISC-V Ottawa 首次启动会议：Mike Thompson 将分享开源 RISC-V 生态，Frederic Desbiens 将介绍开源 RTOS，参与者还将共同讨论本地项目方向。

items.title: CHIPS Alliance Latch-Up recap connects SV Tools, Verilator, VeeR, and open PDK work
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance's Latch-Up 2026 recap packages technical updates on SV Tools, UVM and four-state logic work in Verilator, VeeR/Guineveer open-source SoC flows, and IHP open PDK and MPW progress.
items.titleZh: CHIPS Alliance Latch-Up 回顾串联 SV Tools、Verilator、VeeR 与开放 PDK 工作
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 的 Latch-Up 2026 回顾集中呈现 SV Tools、Verilator 中的 UVM 与四态逻辑进展、VeeR/Guineveer 开源 SoC 流程，以及 IHP 开放 PDK 与 MPW 进展。

items.title: MLCommons releases MLPerf Mobile v6.0 with on-device LLM benchmarks
items.summary: MLCommons released MLPerf Mobile v6.0 with generative AI tests for Llama 3.2 1B/3B and Llama 3.1 8B on Android devices, plus NPU-accelerated Llama 3.1 8B support on Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and updated MediaTek Dimensity 9500 and Samsung Exynos 2600 coverage.
items.titleZh: MLCommons 发布 MLPerf Mobile v6.0，加入端侧 LLM benchmark
items.summaryZh: MLCommons 发布 MLPerf Mobile v6.0，为 Android 设备加入基于 Llama 3.2 1B/3B 与 Llama 3.1 8B 的生成式 AI 测试，并增加 Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 上的 Llama 3.1 8B NPU 加速支持，同时更新 MediaTek Dimensity 9500 与 Samsung Exynos 2600 覆盖。

items.title: OpenHW uses RISC-V Summit Europe 2026 to showcase CVA6, CORE-ET, UAP, and Eclipse collaboration
items.summary: OpenHW Foundation joined RISC-V Summit Europe 2026 in Bologna as a Silver Sponsor, highlighting CVE2, CVE4, and CVA6 roadmap discussions, a CVA6 tech meetup covering Rigoletto and Tristan verification, the Unified Access Platform for EU RISC-V artifacts, and the newly announced CORE-ET silicon platform.
items.titleZh: OpenHW 在 RISC-V Summit Europe 2026 展示 CVA6、CORE-ET、UAP 与 Eclipse 协作
items.summaryZh: OpenHW Foundation 以 Silver Sponsor 身份参加 Bologna 的 RISC-V Summit Europe 2026，集中展示 CVE2、CVE4 与 CVA6 路线讨论，围绕 Rigoletto 和 Tristan verification 的 CVA6 tech meetup，面向欧盟 RISC-V artifact 的 Unified Access Platform，以及新近宣布的 CORE-ET 硅平台。

items.title: RISC-V Summit Europe posters show CVA6 momentum in CFI, secure boot, safety, and real-time designs
items.summary: The Summit Europe 2026 poster program includes multiple CVA6-focused results: CVA6-CFI integrates the RISC-V Zicfiss and Zicfilp CFI extensions with 1.0% 22 nm FDX area overhead, while other posters cover CVA6-based secure boot with DICE and post-quantum cryptography, CAGE-V confidential computing, fault-tolerant CVA6, and CVA6-RT real-time extensions.
items.titleZh: RISC-V Summit Europe poster 显示 CVA6 在 CFI、安全启动、功能安全与实时设计上的进展
items.summaryZh: Summit Europe 2026 的 poster program 包含多项 CVA6 相关成果：CVA6-CFI 将 RISC-V Zicfiss 与 Zicfilp CFI 扩展集成到 CVA6，并给出 22 nm FDX 下 1.0% 面积开销；其他 poster 还覆盖基于 CVA6 的 secure boot、DICE 与 post-quantum cryptography、CAGE-V confidential computing、fault-tolerant CVA6，以及 CVA6-RT 实时扩展。

items.title: OpenHW points to Eclipse ThreadX poster work for first-class RISC-V RTOS support
items.summary: OpenHW highlighted the RISC-V Summit Europe poster by Eclipse Foundation's Frederic Desbiens and 10xEngineers' Akif Ejaz on elevating Eclipse ThreadX into a first-class RTOS for RISC-V, connecting OpenHW's hardware focus with Eclipse's embedded software stack.
items.titleZh: OpenHW 关注 Eclipse ThreadX poster，推动 RISC-V 上的一流 RTOS 支持
items.summaryZh: OpenHW 转发了 Eclipse Foundation 的 Frederic Desbiens 与 10xEngineers 的 Akif Ejaz 在 RISC-V Summit Europe 的 poster，主题是将 Eclipse ThreadX 提升为 RISC-V 上的一流 RTOS，体现 OpenHW 硬件生态与 Eclipse 嵌入式软件栈之间的连接。

items.title: OpenTitan publishes first Earl Grey 1.0.0 development bundle
items.summary: lowRISC published the first OpenTitan development bundle for Earl Grey 1.0.0, packaging FPGA bitstreams, a Verilated simulation binary, OpenTitanTool, HSMTool, test ROM, and FPGA ROM extension binaries for bring-up and integration work.
items.titleZh: OpenTitan 发布首个 Earl Grey 1.0.0 development bundle
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 发布了面向 Earl Grey 1.0.0 的首个 OpenTitan development bundle，打包 FPGA bitstream、Verilated simulation binary、OpenTitanTool、HSMTool、test ROM 以及 FPGA ROM extension binary，便于 bring-up 与集成工作。

items.title: Antmicro outlines Yocto-based open hardware stack for NVIDIA Jetson edge AI
items.summary: Antmicro connected NVIDIA's Jetson Yocto support with its own open source hardware baseboards, meta-antmicro Yocto layers, RDFM OTA and fleet management, Kenning AI benchmarking, and Protoplaster factory testing stack for reproducible edge-AI product development.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 介绍面向 NVIDIA Jetson 边缘 AI 的 Yocto 与开源硬件栈
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 将 NVIDIA Jetson 的 Yocto 支持与自家的开源硬件 baseboard、meta-antmicro Yocto layer、RDFM OTA 与 fleet management、Kenning AI benchmark，以及 Protoplaster 工厂测试栈串联起来，面向可复现的边缘 AI 产品开发。

items.title: FOSSi opens ORConf 2026 registration for its European open silicon conference
items.summary: FOSSi Foundation opened registration for ORConf 2026, scheduled for September 11-13 at the Zebrastraat event center in Ghent, Belgium, and co-located with FPL 2026. Talk submissions are open until August 16 for open-source silicon, EDA, FPGA, IP, and verification work.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 开放 ORConf 2026 注册，聚焦欧洲 open silicon 社区
items.summaryZh: FOSSi Foundation 已开放 ORConf 2026 注册；会议计划于 9 月 11-13 日在比利时 Ghent 的 Zebrastraat event center 举行，并与 FPL 2026 同地举办。面向开源硅、EDA、FPGA、IP 与 verification 工作的演讲投稿开放到 8 月 16 日。

items.title: CHIPS Alliance recaps OCP EMEA work across Caliptra, OpenPRoT, and VeeR
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance's OCP EMEA Summit recap highlights collaboration with the Open Compute Project around Caliptra, OpenPRoT, and Guineveer/VeeR EL2, including root-of-trust and open-source silicon infrastructure themes relevant to data-center security hardware.
items.titleZh: CHIPS Alliance 回顾 OCP EMEA 上的 Caliptra、OpenPRoT 与 VeeR 协作
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 的 OCP EMEA Summit 回顾强调其与 Open Compute Project 围绕 Caliptra、OpenPRoT 以及 Guineveer/VeeR EL2 的协作，重点覆盖 root-of-trust 与开源硅基础设施，对数据中心安全硬件方向具有参考价值。

items.title: Fraunhofer AISEC becomes an official OpenTitan security testing partner
items.summary: lowRISC announced that Fraunhofer AISEC joined the OpenTitan coalition as an official security testing partner, adding independent physical attack evaluation, side-channel and fault-injection expertise, and assurance work around the Earl Grey secure microcontroller.
items.titleZh: Fraunhofer AISEC 成为 OpenTitan 官方安全测试伙伴
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 宣布 Fraunhofer AISEC 作为官方安全测试伙伴加入 OpenTitan 联盟，将为 Earl Grey 安全微控制器带来独立的物理攻击评估、side-channel 与 fault-injection 专业能力，以及更系统的安全 assurance 工作。

items.title: Antmicro makes its open hardware Jetson Orin baseboard directly available through System Designer
items.summary: Antmicro announced that its open hardware baseboard for the NVIDIA Jetson Orin family is available for direct purchase through System Designer, with schematics, assets, customization paths, and AI edge-development use cases presented as part of the platform.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 通过 System Designer 直接提供开源硬件 Jetson Orin baseboard
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 宣布，其面向 NVIDIA Jetson Orin 系列的开源硬件 baseboard 已可通过 System Designer 直接购买，并提供 schematics、设计资产、定制路径以及面向边缘 AI 开发的使用场景。

items.title: Realtek joins the OpenTitan coalition to build discrete hardware root-of-trust devices
items.summary: lowRISC and Realtek announced that Realtek has joined the OpenTitan project as a coalition partner and plans to use OpenTitan's platform-agnostic IP, firmware, and verification collateral to develop discrete hardware root-of-trust devices for networking, telecom, and IoT products.
items.titleZh: Realtek 加入 OpenTitan 联盟，推进离散式硬件 root-of-trust 器件开发
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 与 Realtek 宣布，Realtek 已作为联盟伙伴加入 OpenTitan 项目，并计划基于 OpenTitan 平台无关的 IP、firmware 与 verification collateral，面向网络、通信和 IoT 产品开发离散式硬件 root-of-trust 器件。

items.title: Ainekko's CORE-ET edge AI silicon platform becomes an OpenHW Foundation project
items.summary: Ainekko announced that its CORE-ET Silicon Platform has been accepted as an OpenHW Foundation project. The platform combines many-core 64-bit RISC-V compute, MRAM-based memory, a scalable NoC, an architecture emulator, and open tooling for low-power edge AI inference.
items.titleZh: Ainekko 的 CORE-ET 边缘 AI 硅平台成为 OpenHW Foundation 开源项目
items.summaryZh: Ainekko 宣布其 CORE-ET Silicon Platform 已被 OpenHW Foundation 接收为开源项目。该平台结合 many-core 64-bit RISC-V compute、MRAM-based memory、可扩展 NoC、architecture emulator 与开放工具链，面向低功耗边缘 AI 推理。

items.title: Chisel v7.13.0 released with ChiselTest compatibility and FIRRTL 7 backend updates
items.summary: Chisel v7.13.0 adds a ChiselTest compatibility layer for Chisel 7, debug intrinsics for Chisel type metadata, and bumps the FIRRTL backend to 7.0.0 while carrying several core fixes and documentation updates.
items.titleZh: Chisel v7.13.0 发布，带来 ChiselTest 兼容层与 FIRRTL 7 后端更新
items.summaryZh: Chisel v7.13.0 新增面向 Chisel 7 的 ChiselTest compatibility layer、用于 Chisel type metadata 的 debug intrinsic，并将 FIRRTL backend 升级到 7.0.0，同时包含多项 core fix 与文档更新。

items.title: Yosys 0.66 released with Lattice Nexus DSP inference and GateMate synthesis updates
items.summary: Yosys 0.66 adds the lattice_dsp_nexus pass for Lattice Nexus DSP inference, extends synth_gatemate with a scopename option propagated to flatten, and moves the project baseline toward C++20 with a future CMake migration planned.
items.titleZh: Yosys 0.66 发布，加入 Lattice Nexus DSP inference 与 GateMate 综合更新
items.summaryZh: Yosys 0.66 新增 lattice_dsp_nexus pass，用于 Lattice Nexus DSP inference；同时为 synth_gatemate 增加可传递到 flatten 的 scopename option，并将项目基线推进到 C++20，后续计划迁移到 CMake。

items.title: Fraunhofer AISEC joins OpenHW Foundation to advance secure CVA6/OpenTitan platforms
items.summary: Fraunhofer AISEC joined the OpenHW Foundation and described work on a secure SoC built around the RISC-V CVA6 core and OpenTitan root-of-trust platform, with GyroidOS already running on a CVA6 FPGA reference platform.
items.titleZh: Fraunhofer AISEC 加入 OpenHW Foundation，推进基于 CVA6 与 OpenTitan 的安全平台
items.summaryZh: Fraunhofer AISEC 宣布加入 OpenHW Foundation，并介绍其围绕 RISC-V CVA6 core 与 OpenTitan root-of-trust 平台开发安全 SoC 的工作；其 GyroidOS 已运行在采用 CVA6 core 的 FPGA 参考平台上。

items.title: OpenTitan details its pre-silicon security simulation and verification flow
items.summary: lowRISC outlined how OpenTitan validates side-channel and fault-injection countermeasures before tape-out, combining open-source tooling such as CocoAlma and PROLEAD with formal and simulation-based flows to catch vulnerabilities earlier in the security lifecycle.
items.titleZh: OpenTitan 详解其 pre-silicon 安全仿真与验证流程
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 介绍了 OpenTitan 在 tape-out 前如何验证 side-channel 与 fault-injection countermeasure：将 CocoAlma、PROLEAD 等开源工具与 formal、simulation-based flow 结合，在安全开发生命周期更早阶段发现漏洞。

items.title: Antmicro brings IEEE-compliant force/release statement support to Verilator
items.summary: Antmicro detailed a runtime force-tracking implementation for Verilator that supports conditional and overlapping SystemVerilog force/release statements more closely aligned with IEEE 1800-2023, with the work included in Verilator 5.048.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 为 Verilator 带来更接近 IEEE 规范的 force/release statement 支持
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 介绍了 Verilator 中基于 runtime force tracking 的实现，使其能更好支持 SystemVerilog 中 conditional 与 overlapping force/release statement，并更接近 IEEE 1800-2023 规范；相关工作已进入 Verilator 5.048。

items.title: Real Intent joins OpenTitan as tools partner for static sign-off and verification
items.summary: lowRISC announced that Real Intent has joined the OpenTitan coalition as an official tools partner, adding access to static sign-off tools for hardware security, linting, clock-domain crossing, and reset-domain crossing checks.
items.titleZh: Real Intent 加入 OpenTitan，成为 static sign-off 与验证工具合作伙伴
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 宣布 Real Intent 加入 OpenTitan 联盟并成为官方工具合作伙伴，为 OpenTitan 工程社区带来 hardware security、linting、CDC 与 RDC 等 static sign-off 工具支持。

items.title: Cadence joins OpenTitan as a tools partner for open-source silicon security
items.summary: lowRISC announced that Cadence has joined the OpenTitan coalition as an official tools partner, bringing enterprise EDA support across verification, formal analysis, synthesis, and physical implementation for OpenTitan designs.
items.titleZh: Cadence 加入 OpenTitan，成为开源硅安全项目工具合作伙伴
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 宣布 Cadence 加入 OpenTitan 联盟并成为官方工具合作伙伴，为 OpenTitan 设计在验证、形式化分析、综合和物理实现等环节提供企业级 EDA 支持。

items.title: RISC-V International launches a single library for ratified specifications
items.summary: RISC-V International introduced the Ratified Specifications Library, a consolidated site for ratified RISC-V specifications in HTML and PDF formats, designed to replace scattered repository and draft-page discovery paths.
items.titleZh: RISC-V International 推出统一的已批准规格文档库
items.summaryZh: RISC-V International 推出 Ratified Specifications Library，将已批准的 RISC-V 规格以 HTML 和 PDF 形式集中呈现，减少过去分散在多个仓库和草稿页面中的查找成本。

items.title: RISC-V International highlights a performance-model-driven superscalar CVA6 effort
items.summary: RISC-V International featured Thales' work on a cycle-based Python performance model for CVA6, used to guide a dual-issue CVA6 implementation and improve CoreMark/MHz with modest power and area overhead.
items.titleZh: RISC-V International 介绍基于性能模型推进 superscalar CVA6 的工作
items.summaryZh: RISC-V International 介绍了 Thales 围绕 CVA6 建立 cycle-based Python 性能模型的工作，用它指导 dual-issue CVA6 实现，并在较小功耗与面积开销下提升 CoreMark/MHz。

items.title: Yosys 0.65 released with arithmetic tree and Verilog frontend updates
items.summary: Yosys 0.65 adds an arith_tree pass for converting add/sub/macc chains to carry-save adder trees, removes the share -force option, and improves read_verilog support for positional assignment patterns for unpacked arrays.
items.titleZh: Yosys 0.65 发布，带来 arithmetic tree 与 Verilog 前端更新
items.summaryZh: Yosys 0.65 新增 arith_tree pass，可将 add/sub/macc 链转换为 carry-save adder tree；同时移除 share -force option，并改进 read_verilog 对 unpacked array positional assignment pattern 的支持。

items.title: CIRCT firtool-1.149.0 adds lower-to-core FIRRTL printing, SimToSV fixes, and broader ESI runtime support
items.summary: The latest CIRCT firtool release adds lower-to-core support for firrtl.fprintf, several SimToSV lowering fixes, larger-than-64-bit integral support in the ESI runtime, Windows cosim improvements, and new synthesis and equivalence-checking updates.
items.titleZh: CIRCT firtool-1.149.0 发布，带来 lower-to-core FIRRTL 打印、SimToSV 修复与更广泛的 ESI runtime 支持
items.summaryZh: 最新 CIRCT firtool 版本加入 firrtl.fprintf 的 lower-to-core 支持，修复多项 SimToSV lowering 问题，为 ESI runtime 增加大于 64 位整数支持，改进 Windows cosim，并带来新的综合与等价检查更新。

items.title: OpenTitan publishes its physical security testing framework for pre- and post-silicon validation
items.summary: lowRISC detailed OpenTitan's open physical security testing framework, which coordinates side-channel and fault-injection evaluation from FPGA-based pre-silicon analysis through post-silicon certification and is wired into CI to catch regressions in the security validation flow.
items.titleZh: OpenTitan 发布其物理安全测试框架，覆盖 pre-silicon 与 post-silicon 验证
items.summaryZh: lowRISC 详细介绍了 OpenTitan 的开放式物理安全测试框架：它将 side-channel 与 fault-injection 评估从基于 FPGA 的 pre-silicon 分析延伸到 post-silicon 认证，并接入 CI 以发现安全验证流程中的回归问题。

items.title: Antmicro adds a genetic-algorithm resynthesis path to OpenROAD
items.summary: Antmicro described a genetic-algorithm-based local resynthesis strategy for OpenROAD that complements simulated annealing, exposing tunable search parameters and showing cases where targeted tuning improves timing and power on selected OpenROAD-flow-scripts designs.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 为 OpenROAD 增加基于 genetic algorithm 的重综合路径
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 介绍了面向 OpenROAD 的 genetic algorithm 本地重综合策略，作为 simulated annealing 的补充；该方法开放可调搜索参数，并展示了在部分 OpenROAD-flow-scripts 设计上通过定向调参改善时序与功耗的案例。

items.title: OCP expands its open data center ecosystem for AI with new cluster, networking, and chiplet contributions
items.summary: OCP announced newly approved AI infrastructure contributions spanning Open Rack Wide, Ethernet-based AI cluster reference architectures, facility power and telemetry work, and the Foundation Chiplet System Architecture, extending its open 'chip to grid' roadmap for AI deployments.
items.titleZh: OCP 通过新的集群、网络与 chiplet 贡献扩展开源 AI 数据中心生态
items.summaryZh: OCP 宣布多项面向 AI 基础设施的新批准贡献，覆盖 Open Rack Wide、基于以太网的 AI 集群参考架构、机房电力与遥测工作以及 Foundation Chiplet System Architecture，进一步扩展其面向 AI 部署的开放“从 chip 到 grid”路线图。

items.title: MLCommons Chakra expands its standardized trace ecosystem for AI systems co-design
items.summary: MLCommons reported that Chakra has grown into a 40-plus-member effort with execution-trace support in PyTorch, NVIDIA NeMo, vLLM, ASTRA-sim, and commercial simulators, giving AI hardware and infrastructure teams a more portable way to benchmark and co-design training and inference systems.
items.titleZh: MLCommons Chakra 扩展面向 AI 系统协同设计的标准化 trace 生态
items.summaryZh: MLCommons 表示 Chakra 已发展成拥有 40 多家成员的协作项目，execution trace 已支持 PyTorch、NVIDIA NeMo、vLLM、ASTRA-sim 以及商业模拟器，为 AI 硬件与基础设施团队提供更可移植的 benchmark 与协同设计方法。

items.title: Apache TVM v0.24.0 ships compiler, runtime, and CI modernization updates
items.summary: Apache TVM v0.24.0 bundles broad fixes across code generation and runtime backends while adding fresh architecture documentation and modernizing developer workflows with uv-based Python dependency management and a GitHub Actions lint path.
items.titleZh: Apache TVM v0.24.0 发布，带来编译器、运行时与 CI 现代化更新
items.summaryZh: Apache TVM v0.24.0 汇总了 code generation 与 runtime backend 的多项修复，同时补充新的架构文档，并通过基于 uv 的 Python 依赖管理和 GitHub Actions lint 流程推进开发工作流现代化。

items.title: MLCommons adds GPT-OSS 20B as a sparse MoE pretraining benchmark for MLPerf Training v6.0
items.summary: MLCommons described GPT-OSS 20B, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts pretraining benchmark for MLPerf Training v6.0 designed to run on a single 8-GPU node while testing MoE routing, sparse computation, and hardware/software training efficiency.
items.titleZh: MLCommons 为 MLPerf Training v6.0 增加 GPT-OSS 20B sparse MoE 预训练 benchmark
items.summaryZh: MLCommons 介绍 GPT-OSS 20B，这是面向 MLPerf Training v6.0 的 sparse Mixture-of-Experts 预训练 benchmark，目标是在单个 8-GPU 节点上测试 MoE routing、稀疏计算以及硬件/软件训练效率。

items.title: Antmicro adds Renode support for RISC-V Andes D25F-based ChromiumOS FPMCU testing
items.summary: Antmicro expanded simulation-based testing for Google's ChromiumOS fingerprint firmware module by adding Renode support for an Egis ET171 platform based on the RISC-V Andes D25F core and Zephyr RTOS.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 为基于 RISC-V Andes D25F 的 ChromiumOS FPMCU 测试加入 Renode 支持
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 扩展了 Google ChromiumOS 指纹固件模块的仿真测试能力，为基于 RISC-V Andes D25F core 与 Zephyr RTOS 的 Egis ET171 平台加入 Renode 支持。

items.title: FOSSi publishes Mike Thompson's Latch-Up talk on RISC-V in space
items.summary: FOSSi published Mike Thompson's Latch-Up 2026 talk, "RISC-V in Space (The Canadian version)". The talk describes a Canadian effort with the University of Saskatchewan and collaborators to fabricate an open-source RISC-V chip, radiation-harden the design, and build a space-ready chip; the MCU is based on OpenHW Foundation's CV32E40P.
items.titleZh: FOSSi 发布 Mike Thompson 关于 RISC-V in Space 的 Latch-Up 演讲
items.summaryZh: FOSSi 发布了 Mike Thompson 在 Latch-Up 2026 的演讲 “RISC-V in Space (The Canadian version)”。该演讲介绍加拿大团队与 University of Saskatchewan 等合作伙伴从开源 RISC-V core 出发完成 silicon、进行抗辐照加固，并推进 space-ready chip；其中 MCU 基于 OpenHW Foundation 的 CV32E40P。

items.title: Gemmini v0.7.1 adds rectangular convolutions and new Timeloop configurations
items.summary: Gemmini v0.7.1 is an incremental accelerator release that adds rectangular convolution support, ships new Timeloop configurations, improves area for runtime-configurable dataflows, and speeds up build and elaboration time.
items.titleZh: Gemmini v0.7.1 加入矩形卷积支持与新的 Timeloop 配置
items.summaryZh: Gemmini v0.7.1 是一次增量版本更新，加入对矩形卷积的支持，提供新的 Timeloop 配置，改善运行时可配置数据流的面积表现，并缩短构建与 elaboration 时间。

items.title: Docker on RISC-V reaches near-release parity in six days with native RISC-V64 builds
items.summary: RISC-V International highlighted a community pipeline that brought Docker v29 to RISC-V64 within six days of release using native RISC-V hardware builds for Docker Engine, CLI, Compose, and Buildx.
items.titleZh: Docker on RISC-V 在六天内实现接近正式版本的原生 RISC-V64 交付
items.summaryZh: RISC-V International 介绍了一个社区维护的交付流水线：在 Docker v29 发布后六天内，利用原生 RISC-V 硬件完成 Docker Engine、CLI、Compose 与 Buildx 的 RISC-V64 构建与发布。

items.title: OpenHW publishes CV32A60X 6.0.0 configuration release for TRL5 work
items.summary: The OpenHW CVA6 repository published CV32A60X 6.0.0 as a dedicated configuration release, adding an OBI-based pipeline hierarchy, removing caches and PMP entries, and improving coverage, lint results, and configuration documentation.
items.titleZh: OpenHW 发布面向 TRL5 工作的 CV32A60X 6.0.0 配置版本
items.summaryZh: OpenHW 在 CVA6 仓库发布了面向特定配置的 CV32A60X 6.0.0 版本，引入基于 OBI 的 pipeline hierarchy，移除 caches 与 PMP entries，并改进 coverage、lint 结果与配置文档。

items.title: RISC-V Architecture Tests 4.0.0 released
items.summary: ACT 4.0 is a major update to the RISC-V Architecture Certification Test suite, replacing the older riscof/riscv-ctg/riscv-isac/riscv-config flow with a new Python-based flow.
items.titleZh: RISC-V Architecture Tests 发布 4.0.0
items.summaryZh: ACT 4.0 是 RISC-V 架构认证测试套件的一次重要升级，用新的 Python-based flow 取代旧的 riscof/riscv-ctg/riscv-isac/riscv-config 流程。

items.title: MLPerf Inference v6.0 expands GPT-OSS and DeepSeek-R1 LLM benchmarks
items.summary: MLCommons detailed new MLPerf Inference v6.0 workloads for GPT-OSS 120B and a latency-constrained DeepSeek-R1 interactive scenario, including speculative decoding requirements and reference implementation links.
items.titleZh: MLPerf Inference v6.0 扩展 GPT-OSS 与 DeepSeek-R1 LLM benchmark
items.summaryZh: MLCommons 介绍 MLPerf Inference v6.0 中面向 GPT-OSS 120B 与 DeepSeek-R1 interactive 场景的新 workload，包含延迟约束、speculative decoding 要求，以及参考实现链接。

items.title: Antmicro implements dual-core lockstep support for CHIPS Alliance VeeR EL2
items.summary: Antmicro described an optional dual-core lockstep feature for VeeR EL2, including shadow-core behavior, multibit control encoding, error reporting, and cocotb/PyUVM-based verification.
items.titleZh: Antmicro 为 CHIPS Alliance VeeR EL2 实现 dual-core lockstep 支持
items.summaryZh: Antmicro 介绍了 VeeR EL2 的可选 dual-core lockstep 功能，包括 shadow core 行为、多 bit 控制编码、错误报告，以及基于 cocotb/PyUVM 的验证方式。

items.title: OCP introduces Foundation Chiplet System Architecture for open chiplet interoperability
items.summary: OCP described Foundation Chiplet System Architecture as a CPU-architecture-neutral framework for chiplet systems, defining common chiplet classes and hardware/fabric-level interface expectations under the Open Chiplet Economy initiative.
items.titleZh: OCP 介绍 Foundation Chiplet System Architecture，推动开放 chiplet 互操作
items.summaryZh: OCP 将 Foundation Chiplet System Architecture 描述为面向 chiplet 系统、CPU 架构中立的框架，在 Open Chiplet Economy 计划下定义常见 chiplet 类型以及硬件/互连层面的接口预期。

items.title: CHIPS Alliance launches the SV Tools Project for SystemVerilog/UVM codebases
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance introduced the SV Tools Project to improve visibility and support for open-source SystemVerilog and UVM tooling, including sv-tests, Verible, Synlig, and RISCV-DV.
items.titleZh: CHIPS Alliance 推出 SV Tools Project，聚合 SystemVerilog/UVM 开源工具
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 推出 SV Tools Project，聚合 sv-tests、Verible、Synlig、RISCV-DV 等开源 SystemVerilog/UVM 工具，提升工具链可见度和维护支持。

items.title: Caliptra RTL v2.1.2 patch release published
items.summary: Caliptra RTL v2.1.2 is a patch release for Caliptra 2.1 RTL, including AES countermeasure and Key Vault hardening plus a future-use ML-KEM Key Vault endianness fix.
items.titleZh: Caliptra RTL 发布 v2.1.2 patch release
items.summaryZh: Caliptra RTL v2.1.2 是 Caliptra 2.1 RTL 的 patch release，包含 AES countermeasure、Key Vault 加固，以及面向未来使用模型的 ML-KEM Key Vault 端序修复。

items.title: OpenHW Foundation launches Unified RISC-V IP Access Platform under TRISTAN
items.summary: OpenHW announced the Unified RISC-V IP Access Platform as part of TRISTAN, positioning it as a unified source for verified, industry-ready RISC-V components and related open-source artifacts.
items.titleZh: OpenHW Foundation 在 TRISTAN 项目下推出 Unified RISC-V IP Access Platform
items.summaryZh: OpenHW 在 TRISTAN 项目下宣布 Unified RISC-V IP Access Platform，目标是集中呈现已验证、面向产业使用的 RISC-V 组件和相关开源资产。

items.title: CHIPS Alliance details modular RISC-V SoC design with Topwrap and Guineveer
items.summary: CHIPS Alliance described an open digital design flow using Topwrap and Guineveer, a RISC-V reference SoC based on the VeeR EL2 core, for modular and reusable SoC construction.
items.titleZh: CHIPS Alliance 介绍 Topwrap 与 Guineveer 的模块化 RISC-V SoC 设计流程
items.summaryZh: CHIPS Alliance 介绍了使用 Topwrap 与 Guineveer 的开放数字设计流程；Guineveer 是基于 VeeR EL2 的 RISC-V reference SoC，用于模块化、可复用的 SoC 构建。
